source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: saveEventsToFile accepts calendarName for both the suggested filename and the exporter title, but sanitizes only the filesystem suggestion. CalIcsExporter adds NAME and X-WR-CALNAME before serializing the item array; an empty array no longer prevents exporting an empty calendar. A known calendar or the sole calendar awaits the file picker/export directly; the choose-calendar dialog invokes a callback and has a separate completion path. Keep title data, filename sanitization and completion contracts distinct. Tests check title properties and actual exported event data, but do not cover empty calendars or titles needing ICS escaping.
title: Calendar export passes a semantic title separately from the filename
